activity.role: Poet and author of Leaves of Grass
activity.notes: Brooklyn first edition of Leaves of Grass in 1855 is one representative publication Activity. Successive revisions through the 1891–1892 deathbed edition are contextual, not a claim of one uninterrupted Brooklyn residence or separate Person/Activity per edition. This is the poet Walt (Walter) Whitman (1819–1892), not his father Walter Whitman Sr., the economist Walt Whitman Rostow, or a fictional namesake. No nursing employment or minor newspaper assignment is promoted to a separate historical-impact rail.
